_comment: A real `create_webhook_trigger` exchange, with the account, routine and webhook ids
replaced by synthetic ones. Nothing else is edited.
Its job is to pin desired_webhook() against the shape the API actually takes, the same
way cowork_trigger_live.json pins observed_trigger(). The body below is not derivable
from the tool schema — it names four nouns and one key — so it was derived by probing a
throwaway routine until the server stopped rejecting it, and it is re-derived the same
way rather than edited by feel.
Four properties of this endpoint are recorded here because nothing else in the repo
would tell you, and each one shapes the code that calls it:
1. The response does NOT echo `filter` back. What was stored cannot be read.
2. A routine `get` does NOT report its attached webhooks (see `routine_get_keys`).
So there is no way to ask the account whether a webhook is already wired.
3. The server does NOT dedup: posting an identical body twice returns two distinct
`trigger_id`s, and the routine then fires twice per event.
4. `events` is NOT validated — `zzz_not_an_event` was accepted with a 200. A typo
creates a webhook that silently never fires, which is why check_webhooks() has to
validate the vocabulary that the server will not.
5. An empty list is not an empty list. Posting `allowed_tools: []` came back with the
full default toolset (Bash, Write, WebFetch, …), and `mcp_connections: []` came back
with every connector on the account. Empty means 'default', i.e. everything — so a
routine registered with an empty grant is the most capable routine in the fleet.
routine_tools() must never return an empty tuple, and a test pins that.
1 + 2 + 3, with no delete action on the API, is the whole argument for the `created`
gate in webhook_plan(): a webhook may be posted only for a routine this run just
created, because that is the only routine provably holding none.

rejections.filter.ref: filter.ref: Extra inputs are not permitted
rejections.filter.branches: filter.branches: Extra inputs are not permitted
rejections.scope: scope: Extra inputs are not permitted
rejections.missing hook_type: hook_type: must be in list [app, url]
